name: Cut the Bonds

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon with which you have expert proficiency.

---
Your belief in freedom can even sever magic. Select a magical effect that has made an adjacent member of your crop clumsy, Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, or slowed. You attempt to counteract that effect using your attack modifier with the required weapon as your counteract modifier. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up. On a failure, you can't attempt to use Cut the Bonds on that effect on that crop member for 24 hours.
